cuwalid.dryp.main_DRYP module

DRYP - Dryland WAter Partitioning Model __date__ = ‘20230801’ __version__ = ‘2.0.1’ __author__ = ‘Andres Quichimbo (andresquichimbo@gmail.com)’ __library__ = ‘dryp’

General command line:

python run_drp_input.py filename_input

param -input_file:

string model name and model parameter filenames in plain txt format

param -settings_parameters:

string model parameter settings in plain txt format

param -riparian_additional_parameters:

string model parameter settings in plain txt format

param -groundwater_additional_parameters:

string model parameter settings in plain txt format

param -projection_additional_parameters:

string model parameter settings in plain txt format

param -inception_additional_parameters:

string model parameter settings in plain txt format

param -overlandflow_additional_parameters:

string model parameter settings in plain txt format

Version(s): 20181130 (1.0.0) –> Development of application for version 3.1.5 of HMC models

cuwalid.dryp.main_DRYP.run_DRYP(filename_input)[source]

This funtion integrates all components of the model, with all model parameters and component settings being specified in the -filename_input- file.
